research_question: Does intermediate semantic resampling or deterministic semantic forking beat completing and terminally ranking the same initial particle pool after all accelerator costs are charged?

dataset.reuse_policy: The common saved trajectories supply only the exact first 2048 generator tokens. Every post-allocation continuation is sampled online.

semantic_verifier.score_source: exact requested next-token logprobs renormalized over A-E

semantic_smc.reason_for_temperature: Smallest tested development temperature that triggered ESS resampling on at least 30% of problems at the first checkpoint under the frozen scores (16/50 at beta=12).

deterministic_semantic_fork.selection: highest current pointwise semantic score with stable ties

requirements: semantic SMC point estimate exceeds self-consistency
semantic SMC point estimate exceeds both terminal semantic selectors
semantic SMC is not dominated in accuracy versus active accelerator seconds
semantic SMC exceeds deterministic semantic forking or preserves materially more final diversity
